title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Архитектура цифрового правительства УДП — разработка TOR и стратегия реструктуризации
title_en: [FORECAST] Presidential Administration UDP Digital Architecture — TOR Development and Restructuring Strategy
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from CW-004: Post-April 2026 reorganization creates new UDP Department of Digitalization. All legacy Mintsifry program TORs being rewritten. High-value advisory contract: architecture of UDP Digital Department, program migration plan, prioritization of legacy projects, new governance model for Tunduk/Infocom, international advisory (Estonian EGA, World Bank). Most time-sensitive window: May-August 2026.
win_probability_rationale: New department, new decision-makers — maximum openness to outside advisors. EU GIZ and WB have historically led such restructuring advisory. First-mover in the window (before TORs crystallize) has disproportionate influence on the entire future program pipeline. Fastest value-creation opportunity in KG.

sources.title: Building a Connected Digital Future: Kyrgyzstan Strengthens GovTech and Digital Health Systems

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Инфраструктура цифрового сома — Phase 2: Офлайн-транзакции и межбанковский клиринг
title_en: [FORECAST] Digital Som Infrastructure — Phase 2: Offline Transactions and Interbank Clearing
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from CBDC law (active_window, deadline Jan 2027). Phase 2 post-bank-integration: offline transaction capability (NFC, QR), interbank clearing integration, AML AI monitoring at scale, cross-border payment pilot with Russia/Kazakhstan, KGST stablecoin/digital-som interoperability. National Bank decision on full rollout expected late 2026.
win_probability_rationale: Phase 2 follows Phase 1 (live tender KG-T-2026-004). Different scope justifies separate procurement. No single incumbent controls full CBDC stack. Offline transaction technology (NFC, secure enclave) is highly specialized — global vendors (Thales, G+D, Giesecke+Devrient) have natural fit.

sources.title: Kyrgyzstan Launches Stablecoin and Sets Sights on a National CBDC by 2026

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Национальная стратегия ИИ КР — разработка документа и дорожная карта
title_en: [FORECAST] Kyrgyzstan National AI Strategy — Document Development and Roadmap
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: National AI Strategy (announced but not signed as of May 2026). UDP Digital Department will commission strategy document. Scope: AI readiness assessment, sector priority map (healthcare, agriculture, judiciary, CBDC), governance framework, AI Skills National Program, AI Sandbox design, international benchmarking vs Kazakhstan/Estonia/UAE AI strategies.
win_probability_rationale: UNDP/WB/GIZ co-funding likely for strategy advisory. Short, high-visibility contract. No incumbent. Global AI strategy consulting firms (McKinsey Digital, Oxford Insights) plus smaller specialized firms (AI policy boutiques) are competitive. Best window: engage UNDP Kyrgyzstan directly in June-July 2026.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Цифровой кодекс КР — система реестра и сертификации ИИ-систем
title_en: [FORECAST] Digital Code KR — AI System Registry and Certification Platform
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST from Digital Code (active_window, deadline Dec 2026). Chapter 23 mandates AI system oversight. Scope: national AI systems registry (all government AI deployments catalogued), conformity assessment framework, algorithmic audit tools, SRO registration platform, public AI impact assessment database, citizen appeal mechanism for AI decisions.
win_probability_rationale: No incumbent — new regulatory requirement. EU GIZ funding makes this donor-rules. Estonian/Baltic e-governance firms specializing in AI governance (AI governance tools are their emerging specialty) are natural fit. Lightweight SaaS solution preferred given KG scale.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] АМЛ-система для коммерческих банков — обновление соответствия Digital Code
title_en: [FORECAST] AML System for Commercial Banks — Digital Code Compliance Upgrade
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: Digital Code compliance requirements for fintech and banking sector. Scope: AI-based AML transaction monitoring upgrade for all licensed banks, KYC automation with digital ID integration, virtual asset monitoring integration (post-USDKG), cross-border transaction screening, reporting automation to FSA and National Bank. Serves 22 licensed commercial banks.
win_probability_rationale: Regulatory-driven procurement — mandate creates non-negotiable demand. Existing bank-level AML vendors (FICO, Temenos, Finastra) have incumbent relationships in some KG banks. New digital asset monitoring is a gap. Boutique regtech firms with CIS banking experience (Intersoft, ComplianceTech) are competitive.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] ИИ в парламенте — система мониторинга Жогорку Кенеш и обработки законодательного контента
title_en: [FORECAST] AI in Parliament — Jogorku Kenesh Legislative Monitoring and Content Processing System
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: KG Parliament AI coverage already announced publicly. Scope: AI-powered transcription of parliamentary sessions (Kyrgyz/Russian bilingual), automatic legislative summary generation, public Q&A system for laws, committee document management AI, integration with cbd.minjust.gov.kg legal database, citizen petition tracking.
win_probability_rationale: Announced explicitly. No incumbent. CQS for advisory/software. Parliamentary AI is a relatively small but high-visibility contract. Kyrgyz/Russian bilingual NLP is a genuine specialization. Estonian Parliament and Lithuanian Seimas digital experience are reference models.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Умное сельское хозяйство КР — спутниковый мониторинг и ирригационный ИИ (ADB/FAO)
title_en: [FORECAST] Smart Agriculture KR — Satellite Monitoring and Irrigation AI (ADB/FAO funded)
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: ADB agriculture modernization program in KG. Scope: satellite imagery for crop monitoring (wheat, potatoes), AI-driven irrigation advisory for Fergana valley farmers, precision inputs recommendation platform, agricultural census digitization, farmer registry AI, disaster risk (frost/flood) early warning integration. Rural connectivity component via AKDN.
win_probability_rationale: ADB donor rules = open competition. Agricultural AI is not dominated by any single CIS vendor. AKDN (Aga Khan) has existing rural connectivity footprint in KG mountains. Roscosmos commercial satellite imagery arm is competitive. EU-sourced precision agriculture platforms (xarvio, Agrivi) are accessible.

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] ИИ для предотвращения катастроф — система раннего предупреждения о наводнениях и оползнях
title_en: [FORECAST] Disaster Risk AI — Flood and Mudslide Early Warning System
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: UNDP/EU Climate Adaptation funding for disaster risk in KG. Scope: AI-based flood modeling using hydrometeorological sensor network, mudslide prediction in Tien Shan foothills, SMS/mobile early warning broadcast system (Russian/Kyrgyz), integration with Ministry of Emergency Situations dispatch, GIS mapping of high-risk zones.
win_probability_rationale: Climate adaptation funding pool is growing (post-COP global commitments). UNDP procurement is transparent. No incumbent in AI disaster risk for KG. Norwegian and Swiss disaster risk specialists (NORSAR, WSL) have global references. Russian hydrometeorological software firms have regional data advantage.

sources.title: UNDP Kyrgyzstan digital and climate programs

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Регуляторный финтех-хаб — площадка для тестирования виртуальных активов и ИИ-финансов
title_en: [FORECAST] Regulatory Fintech Hub — Virtual Asset and AI Finance Testing Sandbox Platform
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: KG is positioning as 'Cryptostan' (April 2026 Diplomat analysis). National Council on Virtual Assets and Blockchain under President drives sandbox framework. Scope: regulatory sandbox software platform, virtual asset test environment, AI-powered regulatory monitoring, self-reporting tools for licensed crypto businesses, connection to BIS regulatory sandbox frameworks.
win_probability_rationale: Unique positioning — few jurisdictions have this specific combination. International regulatory sandbox vendors (Startupbootcamp, IFC regulatory tech) are competitive. BIS Innovation Hub has active sandbox tool program. High visibility for early mover.

sources.title: Welcome to Cryptostan: Kyrgyzstan and the Emerging Crypto Corridor

title: [ПРОГНОЗ] Телемедицина в горных районах — IoT-датчики и ИИ-диагностика (UN SDG Fund)
title_en: [FORECAST] Telemedicine in Mountain Communities — IoT Sensors and AI Diagnostics (UN SDG Fund)
ai_digital_scope: FORECAST: UN Joint Programme 2024-2027 Phase 2 procurement. Scope: telemedicine tablet/device rollout for 200+ rural health posts in mountainous regions, IoT vital signs monitoring devices, AI-powered preliminary triage for common mountain-region conditions (frostbite, altitude sickness, obstetric emergency), satellite connectivity for isolated clinics, AI clinical decision support in Kyrgyz language.
win_probability_rationale: UN procurement rules. Phase 2 of active program (KG-T-2026-006). Telemedicine hardware + AI software bundle. AKDN has existing mountain health infrastructure. Korean medtech (Samsung Medison) and Chinese medical device firms are competitive. Kyrgyz-language AI clinical NLP is unique differentiator.

sources.title: UN Joint Digital Health Programme Kyrgyzstan
